Source: docs/appearance/theme-author-guide.md
Heading: Hooks
Starts at line: 424 (bounded excerpt)


### On `<html>`

| Attribute                       | Values                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `data-theme`                    | `dark`, `light`                                                                                          |
| `data-visual-theme`             | `default` (Marinara), `sillytavern` (Dottore), `stage`                                                   |
| `data-overhaul`                 | `on` (new layout, desktop), `mobile` (new layout, phone and tablet); absent in the old layout            |
| `data-custom-theme`             | The active theme's id                                                                                    |
| `data-seasonal-theme`           | The seasonal look, when one is on                                                                        |
| `data-mari-accent-fx`           | `pulse` or `rgb` while an accent effect runs                                                             |
| `data-chat-id`                  | The open chat's id                                                                                       |
| `data-chat-open-mode`           | The open chat's mode: `roleplay`, `conversation`, `game`                                                 |
| `data-chat-tags`                | The open chat's tags, lowercase with spaces as `-`: style a story with `:root[data-chat-tags~="horror"]` |
| `data-mari-chat-art-behind`     | Present while the chat's background is shown behind the side panels (`--mari-chat-art` is the picture)   |
| `data-marinara-reduced-effects` | Present when ambient animation is reduced                                                                |
| `data-mari-a11y-line-height`    | Present when the user widened line spacing (`--mari-a11y-line-height`)                                   |
| `data-mari-a11y-letter-spacing` | Present when the user widened letter spacing (`--mari-a11y-letter-spacing`)                              |
| `data-mari-a11y-focus`          | Present when strong focus rings are on                                                                   |
| `data-mari-contrast`            | `more` when high contrast is on (the user's choice, or the device asks for it)                           |
| `data-mari-cvd-safe`            | Present when colour-blind-safe colours are on                                                            |
| `data-mari-weather`             | The story weather while it shows: `rain`, `snow`, `fog`… (see [Weather](#weather))                       |
| `data-mari-sky`                 | `dawn`, `day`, `dusk` or `night` while the story weather shows                                           |
| `data-mari-shelter`             | `indoors` or `outdoors` while the story weather shows, when the app can tell from the location           |

### Areas

`[data-component="…"]` names the big areas: `AppShell`, `TopBar`, `ChatSidebar`, `ChatSidebarSlot`,
`RightPanelDesktop`, `RightPanelDesktopSlot`, `CenterContent`, `GlobalOmnibar`, `OverhaulLibraryNav`,
`OverhaulSettingsPage`, `OverhaulLibraryPage`, `OverhaulCardGallery`, `OverhaulEditorHead`,
`OverhaulEditorRail`.

### Parts

| Selector                                                                               | What it is                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[data-mari-part="message"]`                                                           | One message row, in every chat mode: the full width of the chat, with the avatar, name line and bubble inside. Paint the bubble (`bubble` below), not this row, or every bubble sits inside a second box. Also has `data-message-id` and `data-message-role` (`user`, `assistant`, `system`, …) and the message data below                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `[data-mari-part="bubble"]`                                                            | The message bubble itself, in Roleplay and Conversation (`.mari-rp-bubble` / `.texting-bubble`). Background, border, radius and shadow go here |
| `[data-mari-part="message"][data-latest]`                                              | The newest reply from the character                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `[data-mari-part="message"][data-streaming]`                                           | A reply that is still being written                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `[data-mari-part="avatar"]`, `[data-mari-part="header"]`, `[data-mari-part="actions"]` | Inside a message: the avatar, the name line and the message tools                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `[data-mari-part="reasoning"]`, `[data-mari-part="reasoning-text"]`                    | The reasoning toggle (or box) and its text, the same hook on desktop and on phones                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `[data-mari-part="composer"]`                                                          | The message box. `data-composer` is `roleplay`, `conversation` or `game`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `[data-mari-part="home-art"]`                                                          | The stock pictures on Home's cards                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `[data-mari-part="message"][data-vn]`                                                  | The visual novel dialogue box: a message with the same data (character, role, index), plus `avatar` and `header` parts inside                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `[data-mari-part="vn-sprite"]`                                                         | An empty layer behind the VN dialogue box, reaching the bottom of the scene. It has `data-vn-speaker` (the speaker's name as a slug, or their role), `data-vn-speaker-role`, `data-character` and `data-character-id` for whoever is speaking now, so a theme can stand their picture there. `[data-roleplay-vn-media]` has the same attributes |
| `[data-mari-part="message"][data-game-narration]`                                      | The Game narration box. `data-message-role` is `narrator`, or `assistant` with `data-character` and `data-character-name` while a character speaks; `data-segment-type` and `data-expression` describe the current line                                                                                                                         |
| `[data-mari-part="app-backdrop"]`, `[data-mari-part="ambient"]`                        | The backdrop and ambient layers. Their place in the page is fixed; style them with the tokens                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `[data-mari-part="home-widget"]`                                                       | A Home widget card, Professor Mari included. Its frame has `data-home-widget-id` (`recent`, `professor`, `whats-new`, `character-library`, …). Inside: `home-widget-eyebrow`, `home-widget-title`, `home-widget-text`                                                                                                                           |
| `[data-mari-part="top-bar"]`                                                           | The top bar on every device. Split view's second side has its own slim bar with the same hooks (`[data-component="TopBar"]`, `.ov-tab`, `.ov-tab__label`, `.ov-icon-btn`), marked `[data-split-bar]`, so top-bar art and fonts reach it too                                                                                                     |
| `[data-mari-part="page-title"]`                                                        | The big title of a main page: every Library section (Characters, Lorebooks, Connections, Agents…), Settings, Extensions and Docs. Style page titles with this one hook so they match on every page                                                                                                                                              |
| `[data-mari-part="backdrop"]`                                                          | A chat's background image (see Backdrops)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `[data-mari-part="stage-empty"]`                                                       | The game stage with no scene image                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `[data-mari-part="time"]`                                                              | A message's time, in every chat mode                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `[data-mari-part="chat-header"]`                                                       | The conversation header (`data-chat-mode="conversation"`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `[data-mari-part="game-hud"]`, `[data-mari-part="game-tools"]`                         | The Game map-and-party float and the narration tool row

Source: docs/appearance/custom-css-themes.md
Heading: Styling chat windows and drawers
Starts at line: 201 (bounded excerpt)


On a computer, **Chat Settings** opens as a movable window. Its collapsible sections are called **drawers**. A drawer can pop out into its own window, then minimize to a small movable button, called a **bubble**.

Other chat tools use these windows and buttons too, including Game controls, Session, Volume, Game Assets, connected chats and package controls. On a phone, most windows open as full-width panels; Echo Chamber stays a compact window that you can move and resize. Tools moved out of Chat Settings are listed in the movable **Chat tools** three-dot menu; tracker buttons stay separate.

The classes, data attributes and variables below let a theme style these parts together. Your theme's rules override the defaults without `!important`.

### Classes

| Part                                                                                            | Class                                                             |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Window                                                                                          | `.mari-window`                                                    |
| Title bar                                                                                       | `.mari-window__header`                                            |
| Title and its icon                                                                              | `.mari-window__title-row`                                         |
| Title                                                                                           | `.mari-window__title`                                             |
| Title bar buttons (Reset View, favorite layout star, Tracker Panel, pin, lock, close, Put back) | `.mari-window__controls` (each button is `.mari-window__control`) |
| Window content                                                                                  | `.mari-window__body`                                              |
| Resize edges and corners                                                                        | `.mari-window__resize-handle`                                     |
| The corner mark shown while the pointer or focus is in a window                                 | `.mari-window__resize-grip`                                       |
| Drawer                                                                                          | `.mari-drawer`                                                    |
| Drawer header and title                                                                         | `.mari-drawer__header`, `.mari-drawer__title`                     |
| Drawer icon, count badge and **?**                                                              | `.mari-drawer__icon`, `.mari-drawer__count`, `.mari-drawer__help` |
| A collapsed drawer's preview (a tracker's small widget)                                         | `.mari-drawer__summary`                                           |
| Drawer buttons beside the arrow, and the pop-out button                                         | `.mari-drawer__actions`, `.mari-drawer__popout`                   |
| Drawer arrow and content                                                                        | `.mari-drawer__arrow`, `.mari-drawer__body`                       |
| The preview that follows the pointer while a drawer is dragged out                              | `.mari-drawer-ghost`                                              |
| A minimized window's button (bubble)                                                            | `.mari-window-bubble`                                             |
| The live summary a bubble shows instead of its icon (World State's banner)                      | `.mari-window-bubble__banner`                                     |
| The line shown while a dragged bubble lines up with another                                     | `.mari-window-snap-guide`                                         |
| The dot shown while agents run (Chat Settings button, Trackers window)                          | `.mari-agents-running-dot`                                        |

### Data attributes

- `data-window` names a window and its bubble: `chat-settings`, `trackers`, the control windows `control:game`, `control:session`, `control:volume`, `control:assets`, `control:connecte
…

stdout:
Usage: mari images <command>
Discovery: connections [--edit], capabilities [--edit], list assets|backgrounds|sprites|chat-gallery|character-gallery, get <asset-id>
HITL preview: preview --operation generate|edit --prompt <text> [--target <target>] [--source <asset|url|file>] [--connection <id|name|default>]
Create preview asset: generate --prompt <text> [--target <target>] [--width <n>] [--height <n>] [--count 1-4] (--count makes that many versions in one go, one request each, for the user to pick from)
Theme art: generate --prompt <text> --target theme-image --theme <theme-id> --name <name> [--width <n>] [--height <n>] (prompt sent exactly as written: the user's style profiles and prompt prefixes are left out; --verbatim does the same for any target)
Adjust a picture without an image model (new preview asset, original kept): adjust --source <asset|url|file> [--crop left,top,width,height (px or %)] [--trim] [--transparent [auto|#hex] --tolerance 0-255 [--everywhere]] [--resize WxH|N --fit inside|cover|fill] [--flip horizontal|vertical|both] [--rotate 90|180|270] [--tint #hex]
Look at pictures yourself (you see them; the user doesn't): look --source <asset|url|file>[,<more>] (up to 4), or look --target theme-image --theme <id> --name <name>. generate/edit/adjust already show you what they made.
Create edited preview asset: edit --prompt <text> (--source <asset|url|file> | --target <existing-image-target>) [--connection <edit-capable>]
Apply: assign --asset <asset-id> --target character-avatar --character <id>
Apply: assign --asset <asset-id> --target persona-avatar --persona <id>
Apply: assign --asset <asset-id> --target lorebook-image --lorebook <id>
Apply: assign --asset <asset-id> --target sprite --character <id> --expression happy
Apply: assign --asset <asset-id> --target background --name <name> [--tags a,b]
Apply: assign --asset <asset-id> --target chat-gallery --chat <id>
Apply: assign --asset <asset-id> --target character-gallery --character <id>
Apply: assign --asset <asset-id> --target theme-image --theme <theme-id> --name night-sky.webp (saved as WebP in the theme; its CSS uses url("theme:night-sky.webp"))
Delete/clear: delete --target asset|character-avatar|persona-avatar|lorebook-image|sprite|background|chat-gallery|character-gallery|theme-image ...
Notes: preview never generates or saves. generate/edit save a review asset only. assign/delete mutate app image state.
